name: Shape-based Transfer Function Generation
definition: Shape classification assigns to each skeleton region a degree of membership in supported shape classes. Only voxels in the pre-segmentation are considered; background voxels are ignored (descriptor set to all zero). Classes are computed independently.
summary: Shape-based Transfer Function Generation assigns optical properties to volumetric features using 3D shape descriptors derived from curve-skeletons, distinguishing features with overlapping intensities by classifying entire segments rather than individual voxels.
